verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity and cap-table management product, so modeling a priced round is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents only cap table record-keeping, reporting, API access and permissions. Nothing covers scenario modeling of dilution, option pool top-ups, SAFE conversion or pro-forma ownership, or sharing such a scenario with counsel and investors.

support.subject: As a founder, I can model a priced round — dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership — and share the scenario with counsel and investors
